title: Recipe 75 — Hybrid models: cheap worker, strong judge

groups.title: Beat 3 · draft cheap, escalate on a failed grade

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: “Last piece: the checker, and what happens when it fails a draft.”
beats.script: We’re preparing a clean scratch state for “Blank the scratch spec,” so this section starts from a repeatable baseline. [[pause:800ms]] Last piece: the checker, and what happens when it fails a draft.

beats.label: Type the cascade and the checker
beats.cue: “on_fail: escalate re-runs the turn on a DIFFERENT rung — retry would re-prompt the model that just missed.”
beats.script: The driver is copying the exact source-backed lines for “Type the cascade and the checker” into the scratch artifact now. [[pause:1.2s]] on_fail escalate re-runs the turn on a different rung — retry would re-prompt the model that just missed. clean_prompt re-runs from the transcript as it stood before the failed draft.

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. Declaring escalate without a model_pool is a spec error — there would be nothing to escalate to.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Lint it” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] Clean. Declaring escalate without a model_pool is a spec error — there would be nothing to escalate to. Expected terminal result: lint: clean — no findings.

verify.note: lint: clean — no findings. Needs CLI 0.6.0 to accept `on_fail: escalate` (and the `models:` block above it) at all; against an installed 0.5.8 the spec fails validation and this beat exits 1, so it tracks factory main

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. The cascade needs no new runtime package, so the bundle installs and boots to the credentials gate.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Compile it and check it” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1.5s]] --check: GREEN. The cascade needs no new runtime package, so the bundle installs and boots to the credentials gate. Expected terminal result: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate.

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (11 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate. Needs CLI 0.6.0 to compile this spec at all; against an installed 0.5.8 it fails validation and exits 1, so it tracks factory main. GREEN only because the cascade wires no side-call closure: a spec declaring strategy.model_directed / policy: classifier / guide / shadow / committee emits an @crewhaus/model-service import, and --check's install cannot resolve that package from the registry until the 0.6.0 release publishes it

beats.label: Audit every slot's model
beats.cue: “models audit walks the same slots as a gate: pricing coverage, requires, and whether each pinned knob survives the adapter.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Audit every slot's model” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] models audit walks the same slots as a gate: pricing coverage, requires against the capability table, and whether each pinned knob survives the adapter's own marshaller.

verify.note: 5 checks across 4 slots, 0 failing. Exit 0 because every model in this spec is priced and current — audit EXITS 1 on a slot whose model is already past its retirement date (`--fail-on none` reports without failing). Needs CLI 0.6.0; tracks factory main

beats.script: The editor is opening the audit artifact for “Read it,” so we can inspect the concrete artifact on screen. [[pause:1s]] A silently-dropped temperature is visible here, offline, before it costs you a run.

beats.command: crewhaus route explain $(ls -t .crewhaus/sessions/*.jsonl | head -1 | xargs basename | sed 's/.jsonl//')

verify.note: reads the session the previous (needs-key) run beat wrote. Empty without one: route explain replays durable model_route / model_directive / model_stage lines from .crewhaus/sessions/<id>.jsonl, so it needs a real credentialed run first
